entries.15cf8ac974b09661: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,309,281 million, up 0.9% year on year, a record high. Revenue from external customers, in order, was: Housing ¥535,944 million (up 2.3%), High-Performance Plastics ¥451,722 million (up 2.1%), Environment and Lifeline ¥225,061 million (down 1.0%), Medical ¥93,721 million (down 5.5%) and Other ¥2,831 million (down 42.2%). Housing revenue rose on higher unit prices per building from the expansion of apartment buildings and high-priced detached houses, and on growth in the renovation business, while High-Performance Plastics grew on higher interlayer film sales in the mobility field. For construction contracts for unit housing and plants in the Housing Business, the company receives advance payments from customers and draws them down as revenue is recognized.

entries.26eb2c3496af5756: This business manufactures, builds and sells steel-frame and wood-based unit houses. In addition to the manufacture, construction and sale of unit houses, it also handles the sale of land for housing development, renovation, residential business, and the sale and installation of interior and exterior products. The manufacturers are the Sekisui Heim Industry companies in Hokkaido, Tohoku, Chugoku-Shikoku and Kyushu, and factory companies such as Sekisui Heim Industry Co., Ltd.; the sales and construction companies are the regional Sekisui Heim sales companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥535,944 million, the largest of the five segments, up 2.3% year on year. Although the number of units sold fell due to sluggish new housing market conditions, revenue increased, driven by a higher average price per unit from the expansion of apartment buildings and higher-priced detached houses, and by growth in the renovation business. Almost all revenue is from Japan (Japan ¥534,583 million, Asia ¥1,361 million). Number of employees was 10,481 (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.38f7c5f2f6435b62: This business manufactures and sells test reagents, testing equipment and pharmaceutical raw materials, among others. It handles clinical test reagents, automated analyzers, blood collection tubes, pharmaceutical active ingredients and intermediates, drug discovery support, enzyme materials and others. Sekisui Medical Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing and sales, and there are also manufacturing and sales companies overseas. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥93,721 million, the 4th-largest, down 5.5% year on year. The medical business remained steady, but overseas testing businesses struggled, due to lower demand in the US for test kits for priority infectious diseases and a slump in the market in China. Revenue was ¥48,767 million in Japan, ¥22,192 million in North America, ¥11,122 million in China and ¥8,969 million in Europe. The number of employees was 2,097 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.55704e6b165bf0c4: This business covers the manufacture, construction and sale of steel-frame and wood-based unit housing, and the sale of land for sale. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, a sluggish new-housing market, along with rising mortgage interest rates and higher prices, slowed the recovery of orders in regional areas, and the number of units ordered fell below the previous year. On the other hand, demand in urban areas remained firm, and the value of orders exceeded the previous year. Expansion of multi-unit residential buildings and high-priced detached houses pushed up the average price per unit, and revenue exceeded the previous year.

entries.6dfc1e3634bad80a: The business manufactures and sells piping, including vinyl chloride pipes and polyethylene pipes, and building materials, and also carries out construction work. It handles vinyl chloride pipes and fittings, polyethylene pipes and fittings, fiber-reinforced plastic composite pipes, sewer pipe rehabilitation materials and methods, rainwater storage materials, building materials (gutters and exterior materials), synthetic wood, non-combustible polyurethane and others. Manufacturing is handled by regional factory companies, including Higher-Nihon Sekisui Industry Co., Ltd. and Nishi-Nihon Sekisui Industry Co., Ltd., and sales are handled by regional companies such as Sekisui Shoji and Vantec Co., Ltd., and there are also overseas subsidiaries for sales and manufacturing. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥225,061 million, the 3rd-largest, down 1.0% year on year. Mainly in the domestic business, the company maintained spreads, and revenue was held at roughly the same level as the previous year despite a continued slump in domestic housing and non-housing markets. Most revenue came from Japan (¥189,090 million). The number of employees was 4,731 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.ad14c1597859f072: It consists of Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd., headquartered in Kita-ku, Osaka City, 91 domestic subsidiaries, 64 overseas subsidiaries and 13 [[term:affiliate|affiliates]] (as of March 31, 2026). [[term:segment|Segments]] comprise four reportable segments (Housing, Environment and Lifeline, High-Performance Plastics and Medical) and “Other,” which is not a reportable segment, for five categories in total; consolidated employees number 26,752. The group vision is to keep opening up the fields of “Creating infrastructure for living and society” and “Chemical Solutions,” and to contribute to improving people’s lives and the global environment around the world.
entries.b42fb7bf358a69d5: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, new adoption of fire-resistant and non-combustible materials and sales expansion of new products progressed well, and adoption of synthetic wood (FFU) sleepers also spread, mainly in Europe, so revenue for the field as a whole exceeded the previous year.
entries.b8371dcd4f16b71f: The business manufactures and sells a wide range of materials and components, including interlayer films for laminated glass, foamed polyolefin, fine particles for LCDs, photosensitive materials, semiconductor materials, optical films, industrial tapes, heat-dissipating materials and CFRP molded products. Tokuyama Sekisui Industry Co., Ltd., which manufactures raw materials and products, Sekisui Polymatech Co., Ltd., Sekisui Seikei Kogyo Co., Ltd., the Sekisui S-Lec companies that make interlayer films, and Sekisui Material Solutions Co., Ltd., a sales company, are the main affiliates, and the business also has manufacturing and sales companies overseas. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥451,722 million, the 2nd-largest, up 2.1% year on year. Growth in interlayer films for the mobility field supported the increase in revenue. Revenue was ¥116,540 million in Japan, compared with ¥118,076 million in North America, ¥81,050 million in Europe, ¥76,026 million in China and ¥52,403 million in Asia, so overseas revenue far exceeds that of Japan. The number of employees was 8,304 as of March 31, 2026.

entries.dc13658586ae96ad: Under its long-term vision “Vision 2030,” the company sets out four business domains (Innovative Mobility, Residential, Advanced Lifeline and Life Science) and a new domain, Next Frontier, and aims to double its business scale by 2030. Under its medium-term management plan “Accelerate 2028,” covering fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028, the company targets revenue of ¥1,600 billion and net income attributable to owners of the parent of ¥102.0 billion in fiscal 2028, and plans to accelerate growth by setting investment allocations for capital expenditure and M&A. For film-type perovskite solar cells, the top priority is launching a 100MW production line in fiscal 2027.
entries.dc3150741031c731: This business is not included in the reportable segments. It manufactures, sells and provides services for products not included in film-type lithium-ion batteries or in the four businesses of Housing, Environment and Lifeline, High-Performance Plastics and Medical. Main affiliates include Sekisui LB Tech Co., Ltd. for manufacturing; Purasuchikku Kogaku Kenkyusho Co., Ltd., Sekisui Bio-Refinery Co., Ltd. and Sekisui Solar Film Co., Ltd. for manufacturing and sales; Sekisui Hoken Service Co., Ltd. for services; and overseas holding companies. Sekisui Solar Film Co., Ltd. was established in January 2025 for the design, manufacture and sale of film-type perovskite solar cells. In addition, a major associated company is Sekisui Plastics Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,831 million (down 42.2% year on year), and including internal revenue or transfers between segments of ¥4,936 million, total revenue was ¥7,767 million. The number of employees was 668 as of March 31, 2026; in addition, 471 employees in corporate (common) functions that do not belong to any segment were employed, and the consolidated total was 26,752.
entries.e14974dee3e930f0: [[term:net-income-attributable-to-owners-of-parent|Net income attributable to owners of the parent]] for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥75,174 million, down 8.2% year on year. It fell below the previous year mainly due to the recording of impairment losses. Environment and Lifeline covered the impact mainly through domestic operations by maintaining the spread between raw material costs and selling prices, and its revenue remained almost unchanged from the previous year. The fiscal 2026 targets are consolidated revenue of ¥1,408.4 billion and net income attributable to owners of the parent of ¥76.0 billion.

entries.e71e9c070e6b0b32: In housing, demand in urban areas remains firm even as the new-housing market is sluggish, and apartment buildings and high-priced detached houses are growing. Environment and Lifeline is affected by domestic residential and non-residential market conditions and by renewal demand arising from the nationwide priority survey of sewerage systems. High-Performance Plastics is supported by market conditions in semiconductors and displays, automotive applications such as interlayer film for head-up displays, and aircraft and drones. Medical is affected by testing markets in the United States and China, while the domestic medical business remains firm. By region, revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥891,457 million in Japan, ¥143,737 million in North America, ¥98,633 million in Europe, ¥90,732 million in China, ¥73,926 million in Asia and ¥10,792 million in other regions, and in High-Performance Plastics, North America is larger than Japan. Products of reportable segments other than the Housing Business are mainly made to stock.

entries.f56bd28ea29af086: The Housing Business centers on manufacturing, construction and sales of steel-frame and wood-based unit housing, and also covers sales of subdivided land, renovation, the residential business, and interior and exterior sales and construction. The Environment and Lifeline Business manufactures, sells and constructs piping such as vinyl chloride pipes and fittings and polyethylene pipes and fittings, rainwater storage materials, building materials, and pipe rehabilitation materials and methods. The High-Performance Plastics Business manufactures and sells interlayer film for laminated glass, foamed polyolefin, photosensitive materials, semiconductor materials, optical films, industrial tapes, heat-dissipating materials and others. The Medical Business manufactures and sells clinical diagnostic reagents, automated analyzers, blood collection tubes, pharmaceutical active ingredients and intermediates, and others. The Other Business handles film-type lithium-ion batteries and others, and Sekisui Solar Film Co., Ltd. was established in January 2025 for the design, manufacture and sale of film-type perovskite solar cells.
